description: This file defines a sealed class 'Serializer' used for converting DocumentObjectModel (MDDOM) into DDL format, including methods for writing, indentation, block management, and comments.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing DocumentObjectModel objects into DDL format, managing indentation, writing comments, and handling nested blocks.

methods.name: IncreaseIndent
methods.description: Increases the indentation level for DDL output.

methods.name: DecreaseIndent
methods.description: Decreases the indentation level for DDL output.

methods.name: WriteStamp
methods.description: Writes header comments with creation info if enabled.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a string to the output, with word wrapping.

methods.name: WriteLine
methods.description: Writes a string as a line to the output, with word wrapping.

methods.name: DoWordWrap
methods.description: Determines how to wrap a string within line length constraints.

methods.name: WriteLine
methods.description: Writes an empty line.

methods.name: WriteLineNoCommit
methods.description: Writes a line without marking the block as 'committed'.

methods.name: WriteComment
methods.description: Writes a comment with automatic word wrapping.

methods.name: CloseUpLine
methods.description: Ends the current line if not already at the start of a new line.

methods.name: WriteToStream
methods.description: Writes text to the underlying stream with optional line break and auto-indent.

methods.name: WriteToStream
methods.description: Writes text to the stream without line breaking.

methods.name: WriteLineToStream
methods.description: Writes a line to the stream.

methods.name: BeginAttributes
methods.description: Starts an attribute block.

methods.name: EndAttributes
methods.description: Ends an attribute block.

methods.name: WriteSimpleAttribute
methods.description: Writes an attribute of various supported types.

methods.name: BeginContent
methods.description: Starts a content block.

methods.name: EndContent
methods.description: Ends a content block.

methods.name: BeginBlock
methods.description: Starts a new nested block.

methods.name: EndBlock
methods.description: Ends a nested block.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Gets or sets the current position within the underlying stream.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the output buffer.

methods.name: Ind
methods.description: Returns a string of spaces for indentation.

methods.name: Indentation
methods.description: Returns the current indentation string.

methods.name: CommitText
methods.description: Marks the current block as 'committed' (contains serialized data).
